verdict.rationale: The evidence shows team-oriented features: Team Bots that sit in shared channels, and a security control that governs which destinations team computers can reach, which is a thin, team-level data and network policy. Other controls such as approval rules, Auto Review and local execution settings read as per-user settings rather than organization-wide admin policy. missing for 10: member invite/removal management, role-based permissions for workspace members, an admin console or org-wide data-retention/privacy policies, and independent corroboration of any admin controls.
